steps.say: Some words do not sound the way they look. We call them tricky words.
Look at said. It sounds like sed, but it has ai.
Look at was. It sounds like woz, but it has a.
To learn a tricky word: look, say, cover, write, then check.
Practise a few tricky words every day.

check.prompt: Which word is spelt the right way?
hints: It ends with two letters: a vowel and y.
Think how it looks in your books.
check.explanation: They is spelt t, h, e, y.

options.why: They ends with e and y.
